_meta.purpose: Every numeric rule of the energy / carbohydrate / sport / season engine, with its basis. test/sciencereview.test.js checks these values against the code so this file cannot drift.

basis.uploaded_reference: value or formula found in a reference uploaded by the project owner (location given)
basis.published_not_uploaded: published source that is NOT among the uploaded references; value typed from general knowledge and not verified here
basis.app_rule: design choice of the app (proposed); no reference

rules.value: 70% of the average deficit on training days; rest-day deficit ≤25% of rest-day TDEE

rules.topic: Base training-day carbohydrate during a deficit (g/kg)
rules.reference: Compare broad2019 Table 3.3: light 3–5, moderate 5–7, high 6–10, very high 8–12 g/kg/d — the app is deliberately lower

rules.value: 9 for events >90 min; 7 endurance/intermittent; 6 other; race day 7–8
rules.reference: broad2019 Table 3.3: fuelling up 7–12 g/kg for 24 h (<90 min events); loading 10–12 g/kg for 36–48 h (>90 min). The app's 9 g/kg for long events is below the reference range

rules.value: ≈1 g/kg carbohydrate + ≈0.3 g/kg protein within 30–60 min
rules.reference: broad2019 Table 3.3 speedy refuelling 1–1.2 g/kg/h for 4 h; Table 3.4 protein 20–25 g; barclay2012 recovery within 30–60 min

rules.value: 1.8 base; ≥2.0 athletes/strength/preserve muscle; 2.2 if lean or deficit ≥20%; max 2.4
rules.reference: broad2019 ch.3 mentions maintaining at least 1.2–1.6 g/kg/d in some contexts; app values are higher by design
